# invoice issuer

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:invoiceIssuer`](gmeow-invoiceIssuer.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/invoiceIssuer>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/finance`](../../slices/finance.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The agent that issued the invoice. Non-functional: a jointly issued invoice has several co-equal issuers.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Invoice`](../classes/gmeow-Invoice.md) -> [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:invoiceIssuer`](gmeow-invoiceIssuer.md) from [`gmeow:Invoice`](../classes/gmeow-Invoice.md) to [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.
